assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of underlying arrhythmia.
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The patient has a history of supraventricular tachycardia.
The patient has a history of sick sinus syndrome.
Prolonged cardiac event monitoring is indicated to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances and guide further management.
